# Pinecrest Outfitters Return Policy

Pinecrest Outfitters is a fictional company used for testing.

## Standard returns

Most items can be returned within 60 days of delivery for a full refund to the original payment method. Items must be unused and include original tags.

## Exceptions

### Kayaks and paddleboards

Kayaks and paddleboards can be returned within 30 days of delivery. A restocking fee of 10% applies unless the item arrived damaged. Customers must book a freight pickup through support.

### Electronics

GPS units, headlamps and other electronics can be returned within 15 days if unopened. Opened electronics are covered by the warranty instead.

### Final sale

Clearance items marked "final sale" cannot be returned or exchanged.

## Refund timing

Refunds are issued within 5 business days after the warehouse receives the item.
